title: Agent Vinod
desc: Agent Vinod uncovers a chilling truth: his colleague's death was orchestrated by a powerful business elite. As tensions rise, he must navigate danger to seek justice and uncover the conspiracy.

title: Hathkadi
desc: ACP Suraj, an honest cop, vows revenge after his innocent brother is killed. But when he's framed for murder and jailed, his fight for justice takes a shocking turn.

title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers reunite to avenge their father's humiliation and murder by Thakur, plotting to marry his daughters as part of a calculated plan to settle scores.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.

title: The Accidental Prime Minister
desc: Amid a tense political climate, economist Manmohan Singh rises to lead India as Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014, navigating challenges with quiet strength and vision.

title: Parmanu: The Story Of Pokhran
desc: Ashwat, an IAS officer, secretly leads a nuclear project. But he must hide everything from American intelligence to make the mission successful and safe.

title: Sooryavanshi
desc: With Mumbai under threat of a major terrorist attack, ATS chief Sooryavanshi launches a high-stakes mission to track down 600 kg of missing RDX and the masterminds behind the plot.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Khiladi 786
desc: The underachieving son of a marriage bureau owner attempts to marry a don's daughter to a supposed police officer in an effort to prove his worth to his father.

title: Khichdi 2: Mission Paanthukistan
desc: When an intelligence agent discovers Praful's uncanny resemblance to the king of Paanthukistan, he seeks the Parekh family's help to replace the missing monarch and save the kingdom from crisis.

title: Upkar
desc: Bharat gives up everything to educate his brother Puran. But Puran becomes greedy and joins the drug trade, forgetting Bharat's sacrifices and love.

title: Indian
desc: Policeman Raj arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise, but when his father-in-law is mysteriously murdered, Raj is framed and must prove his innocence.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.
